changelog:
Initial release of agent-browser: a fast browser automation CLI for AI agents.

- Enables navigation, form filling, clicking, screenshots, data scraping, web app testing, and automation of browser tasks via CLI.
- Supports automating Electron desktop apps (VS Code, Slack, Discord, Figma, Notion, Spotify) and Slack-specific tasks.
- Compatible with browser automation in Vercel Sandbox microVMs and AWS Bedrock AgentCore cloud browsers.
- Built as a native Rust CLI (not a Node.js wrapper) using Chrome/Chromium via CDP, with accessibility-tree snapshots for robust element targeting.
- Offers a modular skill system for specialized workflows and a discovery guide for accessing up-to-date usage documentation.
